text:
emily: Hey — trying to find logs for a customer error. I have request_id=abc123 and trace_id=1a2b3c. Prefer console but also want CLI. Anyone have the concise commands / dashboard links?
kevin: For Console -> Redwood Console -> Observability -> Traces. Paste the trace_id in the trace search box, then click "Open related logs" on the right pane.
emily: I can't find the Traces nav, is there a direct URL?
raj: Direct traces UI (org-scoped): https://console.redwood.ai/observability/traces — you'll need org access.
raj: If you want raw logs in Kibana/prod, use the filter: request_id:"abc123"
raj: CLI: `redwoodctl logs --request-id abc123 --env prod --follow`
ana: small correction: my alias is ana not nana :sweat_smile:
ana: also `redwoodctl trace show 1a2b3c --span-detail` gives the span->log pointers
ana: If trace->log link is missing, check for `span.linked_log_id`. You can run:
```bash
redwoodctl traces export --trace-id 1a2b3c | jq '.spans[] | select(.linked_log_id) | {span_id: .id, linked: .linked_log_id}'
```
ops-bot: Reminder: redwoodctl requires MFA for prod endpoints. Run `redwoodctl login --mfa` if you hit 401.
kevin: One more console trick: paste `request_id:abc123` into the global search bar — it surfaces logs + traces in the same panel.
emily: thanks! i'll try CLI first then console if needed. ping me if you spot anything weird :wave:
raj: if you get too many results, narrow with `--since 1h` or `--service payments` on the CLI.
ana: saved snippet for reference: ```bash
redwoodctl logs --request-id abc123 --env prod --since 30m | less
```
kevin: :thumbsup:
